theorem: For a fixed compact connected simple root system, a supplied dominant carrier Lambda=sum_i n_i omega_i with active set I={i:n_i>0}, n_* = min_{i in I} n_i, and actual equal-marginal compatible covariant bistochastic UCP marginal Phi, the canonical coherent EB channel Psi_Lambda satisfies on every full real W-isotypic block ||(I-Psi_Lambda)A||_(2,tau)^2 <= C_W <A,(I-(Phi+Phi^sharp)/2)A>_tau, with C_W=72 p^2 C_Lambda r_W c_W/[g gamma_(G,I)^2 (n_*+1)^2]. On supplied face-regular cones n_i>=eta N for i in I (inactive labels zero), all Hermitian PBW degree-<=k scores satisfy the same comparison with C_(G,eta)(k)=144 p^2 M_G hvee (1+a_G)^p k^(p+2)/(g gamma_G^2 eta^2).
quantifiers: G is fixed; Lambda is any nonzero allowed dominant integral weight, including singular weights on walls. I is nonempty. A central quotient permits only labels descending to that quotient. The broadcaster marginal is covariant, bistochastic, and has an actual equal-marginal UCP two-output extension; the extension need not be covariant or output-swap invariant. The block claim covers all multiplicities. Uniformity in Lambda is asserted only on a supplied face-regular cone n_i>=eta N on I, with fixed eta>0; no uniformity when n_*/N tends to zero.
proof_or_counterexample: The highest line stabilizer is the partial Levi L_I. Selected active fundamental highest lines embed G/L_I, giving F_I(g)>=gamma_(G,I)d(g,L_I)^2. Exact Schur/Weyl dimension ratios give E_k d(g,L_I)^2<=p/[gamma_(G,I)(n_*+1)]. Holomorphic polarization proves the coherent symbol injective on End(V_Lambda); its Berezin convolution defect on a full W block is <=p c_W/[gamma_(G,I)(n_*+1)]. A Stinespring commutator inequality for an actual broadcaster gives q(B)<=36 epsilon, while projection onto physics-scaled normalized carrier generators gives q(B)>=g c_W/(2 r_W C_Lambda), hence I-S>=g c_W/(72 r_W C_Lambda). Combining yields the stated 72-constant block bound; PBW/Weyl estimates give the stated 144 k^(p+2) face-regular coefficient. Full proof, including the metric/Casimir normalization distinction, is in RESULT.txt.

theorem: For fixed compact connected simple G and every dominant carrier Lambda (including arbitrary walls), let N=sum n_i>=1 and Xi_a=T_a/N for the physics-scaled Hermitian generators. For a family of Hermitian noncommutative polynomial exponents X_x of degree <=D and coefficient l1 norm <=A, the Gibbs family rho_x=exp(X_x)/Tr exp(X_x) has a common coherent EB decoder under an actual compatible covariant bistochastic marginal Phi. No separate operator-norm promise is needed because ||X_x||<=h_pol:=A R_G^D, R_G=max(1,Omega_G/sqrt(2)). If b=sup_x (1/2)||Phi^sharp(rho_x)-rho_x||_1, then e_EB<=K_src/N, with K_src explicit in RESULT.txt (23), and for each K>=1 e_EB<=sqrt(Gamma_G)N(1+DK)^(sigma_G/2)sqrt((exp(2h_pol)-1)b+epsilon_K^2)+epsilon_K/2, where sigma_G=max(|Phi+|-2,0), epsilon_K=exp(2h_pol)h_pol^(K+1)/(K+1)!, and Gamma_G is in RESULT.txt. Optimizing N and K gives O_G,D,A(b^(1/4)[log(1/b)/loglog(1/b)]^(sigma_G/4)).
quantifiers: G,D,A fixed; all carriers in the sequence are supplied dominant weights of this one root system, including walls. N>=1. The polynomial is in the specified physics-scaled generators divided by N; its operator-norm bound h_pol=A R_G^D follows from coefficient l1 and degree. The marginal has an actual equal-marginal two-output extension and is covariant; alternatively the family is supplied G-conjugation-closed so the broadcaster can be twirled. No claim is uniform over root systems or inferred from Holevo capacity alone.
proof_or_counterexample: The exact all-face coherent moment shift Delta(T_X)=Tcal(m_(beta_F,X)) gives ||Delta T_X||<=B_G||X|| in the half-basic metric, with beta_F the sum of active positive roots. Its primary antecedent is Leung-Li-Ma arXiv:2010.14339v1, Theorem 2.4/Eq. (2.5); the cycle6 reconstruction was independently audited for sign, face scope and divergence. A double-commutator word expansion then gives ||Delta P||_1<=A_eff[D delta_G+D(D-1)E_G]/N and E_Psi(P)<=A_eff^2D^2E_G/N, yielding K_src/N after the full ordered exponential bound. Separately, actual compatibility gives I-S>=g c_W/(72 r_W C_Lambda) on every full isotypic block. Using ||I-Psi||<=1 and r_W/c_W<=Rratio_G(1+k)^sigma gives the all-wall target comparison Gamma_G N^2(1+k)^sigma. Taylor truncation of the Gibbs likelihood, the residual bound, and optimization yield the displayed rate. Full derivation is Section 9 of RESULT.txt.

theorem: Given a finite-dimensional family E_n, an actual CPTP two-output broadcaster with worst first-marginal half-trace residual b_n, a faithful reference sigma_n, a supplied PVM {P_j} commuting with sigma_n, and the reference-conditioned EB map R_n(rho)=sum_j Tr(P_j rho) sigma_nP_j/Tr(sigma_nP_j), if eta_n=sup_{rho in E_n}D(rho||R_n(rho))->0, then the single full-domain EB channel Lambda_n(X)=sum_j Tr(B_n^*(P_j tensor I)X) sigma_nP_j/Tr(sigma_nP_j) satisfies sup_E T(Lambda_n(rho),rho)<=b_n+sqrt(eta_n/2). A uniform D(rho||sigma_n)<=C implies chi(E_n)<=C and eta_n<=C, not eta_n->0.
quantifiers: All dimensions, any supplied actual broadcaster and PVM/reference structure, uniform eta_n->0. The number of outcomes may vary; the bound itself has no outcome-count factor. The construction is one channel for the whole family.
proof_or_counterexample: The induced input POVM effects are M_j=B_n^*(P_j tensor I). Their probabilities differ from p_j=Tr(P_j rho) by total variation <=b_n by measurement contractivity. The prepared block states have orthogonal supports, so T(Lambda_n(rho),R_n(rho)) equals that total variation. Quantum Pinsker gives T(R_n(rho),rho)<=sqrt(eta_n/2). The Pythagorean relative-entropy identity under [P_j,sigma]=0 yields eta_n<=D(rho||sigma_n)<=C, which is only a constant. Full proof and a qubit misalignment control are in structured_common_decoder.txt.

theorem: For any fixed c>0 and d->infinity, two mutually unbiased bases on C^d define rho_(b,j)=(1-epsilon)I/d+epsilon P_(b,j), epsilon=c/log d, with Holevo capacity C_d->c. There is an explicit full-domain measure-and-prepare broadcaster whose two marginal channels are the replacement I/d and whose residual on the family is epsilon(1-1/d)->0, yet for its supplied Bell-code extension I(X:B|C)=I(X:C|B)=C_d/2->c/2. The same marginal also has a zero-CMI product extension, and an explicit EB replacement decoder has error tending to zero; thus this refutes only an inference about arbitrary chosen extensions, not the global EB target.
quantifiers: d>=2 with a fixed c and sufficiently large d; the statement concerns the specific explicit broadcaster and the uniform label prior used to define its cq state. No lower bound on optimal broadcasting error or EB error is asserted.
proof_or_counterexample: The two bases give a 2d-outcome POVM P_(b,j)/2; encode its outcome into 2d orthogonal maximally entangled Bell states. Both receiver marginals are exactly I/d. The uniform prior's average is I/d and the entropy formula gives C_d<=epsilon log d<=c. The Bell basis outcome has mutual information C_d/2 with the label, while individual receiver marginals carry zero information, hence the CMI identities. The replacement EB decoder error is exactly epsilon(1-1/d). Receiver-only recovery of the specified cq extension has a Pinsker lower bound sqrt(C_d/4), but this is not an EB lower bound. Full derivation/checks are in approx_markov_collective_correlation.txt.
